name: Newmont Corporation
research_rationale: Quarterly cash generation in the file set still supports the buy signal, yet renewed gold-led selling and momentum-focused downgrades leave the overlay only partly confirmatory.

weekly_updates.summary:
Refreshed quarterly data show solid Q3 earnings, ~$10.1bn TTM free cash flow and continued buybacks; press pieces cite record profit and lower costs at key Australian assets.
Duquesne Family Office disclosed a new ~$44m NEM stake; bullish miner commentary sits alongside third-party notes that the stock still looks rich on some scorecards.
On 18 Nov NEM fell roughly 5–8% with a broad gold sell-off (spot cited below $3,800), compressing margin versus Q3 realised prices per market coverage.

Gold and gold miners remained weak in the batch: spot was cited below about $3,600 on 20 Nov, with miners near yearly lows on yields and a firmer dollar.
Seeking Alpha downgraded NEM on momentum; other pieces still highlight strong cash flow and Druckenmiller/“cheap stocks” interest, alongside overvaluation calls on some models.
No new company filings in this window; the operational picture is unchanged from the 19 Nov data refresh.
